issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category -> Extracurricular Receipts, detail_category student activity receipts] This line is entirely Activities Fund 'Other Activity Income' (school activity receipts). User rule: school activity fund receipts -> Extracurricular Receipts unless the report says otherwise. The detail lines for the same money are already Extracurricular Receipts.

[fixed 2026-10-28: Daily Sales category -> School Lunch Sales in receipts and detail] School nutrition daily sales are meal sales. User rule (2026-10-28) moves lunch/meal sales out of charges for services into 'School Lunch Sales'. detail[...School Nutrition Daily Sales] already has detail_category 'school lunch sales' but category 'charges for services/fees'.

[fixed 2026-10-28: category -> Extracurricular Receipts] The category conflicts with its detail_category (student activity receipts) and with every other Activities Fund receipt (Extracurricular Receipts). A grant account is not a charge for services; it should be Extracurricular Receipts or donations/contributions.
Function code 4700 is facilities acquisition/construction, i.e. capital outlay. The statement folds it into Operation and Maintenance, so this is a judgment call (already marked review).
